item.description:
• Your Kit stops flagging its own thinking as self-contradictory. It checks new memories against what it already knows and raises a conflict when the two disagree, which is worth doing for things you told it and things it decided. It was also doing it to its own inner monologue and its own handover notes between sessions, where two entries hours apart are near-identical by nature, so it kept asking you to adjudicate whether it had contradicted itself. Those two kinds of note are now left out of the check, and the conflicts you are asked about should be real ones.
  • A summary that comes back unreadable is no longer bought twice. If the model returned something your Kit could not parse, the conversation went back to the front of the queue and was sent to the same model again on the next pass, which produced the same unreadable answer. That one is now set aside until the conversation actually grows.
  • Consolidation now records which phase of the night spent what, so a slow or expensive step can be found instead of guessed at.
  • Every surface of your personal Kit now starts with the complete tool set and wakes as the same Kit by default. New and existing Kit facets inherit that access automatically, while explicit outside reviewers and public or federated callers remain separate, non-admin identities.
